label: OBS agent source gap priority model
description: Bounded advisory scoring model for ranking repo-local source gap candidates. Scores are review aids only and do not approve source access or rank accepted truth.

band_definitions.high: 70-100: likely early review target if policy gates are satisfied later
band_definitions.medium: 40-69: useful candidate but either narrower, more uncertain, or more policy-sensitive
band_definitions.low: 0-39: weak local support or high review burden

required_review_notes: Scores do not approve source access.
Scores do not indicate accepted evidence.
Scores do not mutate source cache, evidence ledger, candidate index, public index, or master index.
Future API or metadata probe modes remain deferred until explicit source policy approval exists.
no_goals: No source sync, cache write, evidence ledger write, or public search fanout.
notes: Use stable integer scoring and deterministic sort order.
When local evidence is too thin, record insufficient_local_evidence instead of filling in detail.
